title: Product Manager
description:
2Base Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a Kochi-based IT services and software development company established in 2010. We are a full-service technology partner offering technology consulting, custom software development, enterprise application development, web and mobile application development, and digital transformation solutions. We have delivered across Insurance, EdTech, Hospitality, and Travel & Tourism, and we work with clients in global markets including the US and UK.

The Opportunity

We are building our own technology products, with a strong focus on AI-driven solutions, and we are looking for the person who will own what they become. This is a product at the concept and early development stage. You will shape its direction, validate the market opportunity, decide what is built and what is not, and drive it towards commercial success.  
As our first dedicated Product Management professional, you will also establish the product function at 2Base: there is no existing roadmap, process or product organisation to inherit.

Key Responsibilities

Define the product vision, strategy, roadmap and long-term direction, and keep the roadmap stable enough to plan against and open enough to change when the evidence changes.  
Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and customer discovery to identify and validate product opportunities, and bring the findings into roadmap decisions rather than filing them as reports.  
Translate customer problems and business needs into clear product requirements: the outcome and the user problem, specified well enough for Engineering to build against without dictating the solution.  
Own feature prioritisation and release decisions with Engineering and UI/UX, and be able to state the cost and the benefit of each choice. A roadmap that only says yes is a backlog.  
Identify and evaluate AI, Generative AI and automation opportunities, and assess each on feasibility, scalability, cost and business value before it reaches the roadmap.  
Define product success metrics before the work starts, instrument the product to measure them, and read the results honestly afterwards.  
Contribute to product positioning, pricing, go-to-market strategy and commercial viability, working with Sales and Marketing.  
Build shared context across the organisation so that teams can make decisions without routing every question through you.  
Work closely with the Founder, Engineering, UI/UX, Sales and other stakeholders to align on product direction and drive execution.

What You Will Not Own  
​  
Product Manager and Project Manager are used interchangeably across the market. At 2Base, they are different roles, so the boundary is stated rather than assumed.  
Client project delivery. Project Managers own client engagements, schedules, and escalations.  
Engineering architecture and implementation. You own what and why; Engineering owns how. Where the two conflict, you negotiate rather than instruct.  
UI/UX design execution. The design function designs. You own the user outcome and brief, review and decide against it.  
Final product investment and budget approval. The Founder decides what the product is funded to do and over what horizon. You own the case that decision is taken on.  
Client-specific commercial negotiations. Pricing and packaging of the product itself is yours; client contracts are not.

Requirements  
Experience

6–12 years in the technology industry, with at least 4 years in Product Management or direct product ownership.  
At least one product you took from concept or early development to actual customer usage, with a clear view of what happened after release. A product you inherited fully formed and maintained is a weaker signal than a smaller one you shaped.  
A decision not to build something, and what it cost you to hold that line.  
Direct work with engineering teams through a build, not across a handover, with enough understanding of software development, technical feasibility, APIs, integrations and cloud applications to judge what a decision will cost.  
AI and Emerging Technology  
Practical exposure to AI-powered products, Generative AI, machine learning or automation-driven solutions.  
The ability to tell a capability apart from a product, and to assess an AI use case on feasibility, scalability, cost and business value rather than on novelty.  
Product Judgement

You can describe how you decided what to build: the evidence you had, the evidence you wanted and did not have, and what you did about the gap.  
You can reason about a product commercially. Who pays, what for, and what has to be true for the numbers to work.  
You can hold a position with a founder, an engineering lead or a client, and change it when the argument against you is the better one. Knowing which situation you are in is the skill.  
You write and present clearly. Most of a product manager's influence here travels as writing, and a requirement that is ambiguous on Monday becomes an argument three weeks later.  
Ways of Working  
You start by asking rather than deciding. The first months are spent understanding users, the business model, what has already been attempted, and how decisions are actually made here.  
You work independently and establish your own processes. There is no research function and no analyst to brief.  
You influence without formal authority. Nobody in this structure reports to you, and the roadmap holds because people agree with it.  
You can make a decision that leaves someone unhappy, explain the reasoning, and keep working with them. Trade-offs are the job, and somebody loses every time one is made.  
Education

A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

What We Are Not Looking For  
Stated now rather than at the end of a multi-stage process.  
Project or delivery managers looking to change title. The skills overlap less than the market suggests, and this is not a promotion path from delivery.  
Business analysts who have written specifications against requirements someone else set. Valuable work; different work.  
Candidates whose account of a product is the features it shipped, with no view on whether it should have shipped them.  
Anyone who needs an established research function, design system and process in place before they can start.

Benefits  
A growth-driven environment with opportunities to lead, innovate, and upskill continuously.

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:
Job Description – Customer Relationship Manager (Loans)

Position: Senior Relationship Manager – Loans

Company: Finviyon Business Solutions Private Limited

Location: Kochi, Kerala

Role Summary

Finviyon Business Solutions Private Limited is looking for an experienced and performance-driven Senior Relationship Manager to lead loan sourcing and business development activities.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in the loan industry, an established customer network, a good existing business portfolio (book size), and the ability to generate quality loan leads and convert them into successful disbursements.

Candidates with prior experience in banks, NBFCs, financial institutions or Loan DSA channels are strongly encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

Source and develop business for Personal Loans, Home Loans, Loan Against Property (LAP), Business Loans and other loan products.

Leverage an existing customer base and professional network to generate consistent loan business.

Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, bankers, financial institutions and lending partners.

Manage the complete loan sourcing cycle, from initial customer interaction and eligibility assessment to documentation, approval and disbursement.

Identify new business opportunities through referrals, customer databases, professional contacts and market networking.

Develop and maintain relationships with banks, NBFCs and DSA partners.

Drive monthly sourcing and disbursement targets while maintaining business quality.

Ensure proper customer follow-ups, documentation, CRM updates and timely coordination with lending institutions.

Explore opportunities to expand the company's loan distribution network and customer portfolio.

Business Expectations

Demonstrated ability to generate quality loan business consistently.

A strong existing customer base and established professional network.

Good individual loan sourcing and disbursement track record.

Ability to handle high-value loan cases and develop referral-based business.

Ownership of monthly business targets and revenue generation.

Ability to contribute independently while supporting the company's overall business growth.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary: ₹18,000 – ₹30,000 per month, depending on experience and suitability.

Attractive performance-based incentives linked to business sourcing and disbursements.

Mobile allowance.

Personal Accident Insurance cover.

Opportunity to grow into a senior business development or team leadership role.

Exposure to multiple banking and NBFC lending partners.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Strong experience in loan sales, sourcing or relationship management.

Candidates from Banks, NBFCs, Financial Institutions and Loan DSA organisations are preferred.

Proven customer acquisition and loan disbursement track record.

An established customer database, referral network and good existing loan business book size will be a significant advantage.

Good understanding of Personal Loans, Home Loans, LAP and Business Loans.

Strong negotiation, communication and relationship management skills.

Ability to independently generate business and achieve targets.

Leadership potential and the ability to develop a team as business expands.

Candidates with a strong existing customer portfolio and proven loan business generation capabilities will be given preference.

title: Product UI Engeneer
description:
**Role Overview**  
Join our dynamic team as a Product UI Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in designing and building engaging web interfaces. As part of our team in Cochin, you'll work in an ONSITE environment, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to engineer innovative solutions for large-scale applications while ensuring the highest standards of UI/UX excellence.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Develop robust, high-performance web user interfaces using modern JavaScript frameworks.
* Collaborate with designers, product managers, and engineers to translate Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD prototypes into seamless user experiences.
* Optimize applications for maximum speed, scalability, and accessibility.
* Maintain and continually improve UI codebases using version control best practices (e.g., Git).
* Participate in code reviews, architectural planning, and technical decision-making.
* Champion UI/UX design principles and work to ensure consistency across products.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues to improve overall application quality.
* Stay current with new front-end technologies and trends to ensure product innovation.

**Must have requirements**

* Minimum 5 years of professional experience as a UI Engineer or in a similar role.
* Strong expertise in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern frameworks such as React.js, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Advanced understanding of UI/UX design principles and best practices.
* Demonstrated experience building large-scale web applications.
* Proficient in code versioning tools (e.g., Git).
* Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to work full-time onsite in Cochin, Kerala.

**Nice to have requirements**

* Experience with design tools such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.
* Familiarity with animation libraries and front-end testing frameworks.
* Working knowledge of backend integration (RESTful APIs, GraphQL).
* Exposure to Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
* Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG, ARIA).

**Perks and Benefits**

* Be part of an international group with merit-based growth opportunities.
* Unlock your potential to innovate and create industry-leading solutions.
* Collaborative and creative environment focused on continuous learning.

title: Product Manager
description:
Product Manager – ERP & Enterprise Applications  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office (WFO)  
**Experience:** 5–8+ Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced and business-oriented **Product Manager** to lead the strategy, functional design, and development of our ERP and enterprise software products.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in ERP systems, product management, business process analysis, workflow design, and cross-functional team coordination. The role involves translating business requirements into scalable product features, managing product roadmaps, prioritizing development activities, and ensuring seamless integration across multiple ERP modules.

The candidate will work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Business Analysts, QA, Implementation, and other stakeholders to ensure the delivery of business-focused, scalable, and user-friendly enterprise solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Product Strategy & Roadmap Management

* Define and manage product vision, strategy, roadmap, and development priorities.
* Translate business objectives and customer requirements into scalable product features.
* Identify product gaps, improvement opportunities, and process inefficiencies.
* Prioritize product features and development backlogs based on business value, customer needs, and technical feasibility.
* Ensure consistency across different ERP modules and product functionalities.

2. ERP Functional Design & Business Process Management

* Understand and define business processes across ERP modules such as Finance, Accounting, Sales, Procurement, Inventory, HR, CRM, and Operations.
* Design end-to-end workflows, business rules, approval hierarchies, validations, and transaction lifecycles.
* Define relationships, dependencies, and data flows between different ERP modules.
* Identify functional gaps and recommend process improvements and automation opportunities.
* Ensure the ERP product supports multi-company, multi-branch, and role-based access requirements.

3. Requirements Gathering & Documentation

* Conduct client meetings, requirement-gathering sessions, and business discovery workshops.
* Translate business requirements into product requirements, functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain product documentation, including PRDs, functional specifications, process diagrams, and user guides.
* Ensure requirements are clearly documented and communicated to Engineering and QA teams.
* Maintain requirements traceability and manage scope changes throughout the product lifecycle.

4. Product Development & Cross-Functional Coordination

* Work closely with Engineering teams to translate functional requirements into technical deliverables.
* Collaborate with UI/UX Designers to review wireframes, prototypes, user journeys, and product interfaces.
* Coordinate with Business Analysts, QA, and Documentation teams to ensure product quality and completeness.
* Review functional specifications and product designs before development handoff.
* Monitor product development progress, release schedules, and feature delivery.

5. API & System Integration

* Define functional requirements for REST APIs, third-party integrations, and data exchange.
* Understand JSON, webhooks, API operations, data mapping, and system dependencies.
* Coordinate with Engineering teams to validate integration requirements and error-handling scenarios.
* Ensure seamless communication and data consistency between ERP modules and external applications.

6. Product Customization & Decision-Making

* Evaluate customer requirements and determine whether they should be incorporated into the core product, offered as configurable features, handled through integrations, or developed as customizations.
* Assess business value, development effort, scalability, and long-term maintenance impact.
* Identify recurring client requirements that can be converted into reusable product features.
* Ensure customer-specific customizations do not affect overall product consistency and maintainability.
* Take ownership of functional decisions and resolve cross-functional issues.

7. Client & Stakeholder Management

* Act as a key point of contact for product-related discussions with clients.
* Conduct product demonstrations, requirement discussions, and functional walkthroughs.
* Manage client expectations regarding product functionality, scope, dependencies, and timelines.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Sales, Implementation, Support, and other internal stakeholders.
* Collect customer feedback and identify opportunities for continuous product improvement.

**Required Technical Skills**

* ERP and multi-module enterprise product management.
* Product roadmap planning and backlog prioritization.
* Business process mapping and workflow design.
* Functional specifications, PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and system integrations.
* SQL fundamentals, database relationships, and data mapping.
* Requirements traceability and scope management.
* Agile/Scrum methodologies and software development lifecycle.
* Familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent project management tools.
* Understanding of UI/UX design principles and wireframing tools such as Figma.

**Preferred / Advanced Skills**

* Experience in financial, banking, accounting, lending, or payment-related products.
* Knowledge of BPMN, UML, swimlane, sequence, and state-transition diagrams.
* Familiarity with Swagger/OpenAPI and Postman.
* Experience with approval engines and workflow automation.
* Knowledge of multi-tenant SaaS, multi-company, and multi-branch ERP structures.
* Understanding of audit trails, maker-checker controls, and compliance requirements.
* Experience with user research and usability testing.
* Knowledge of CMMI / ISO quality standards.

**Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies**

* Strong product ownership and decision-making abilities.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Ability to understand complex business requirements and translate them into practical solutions.
* Effective client and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to coordinate and influence multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and take end-to-end ownership.

**Educational Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.
* 5–8+ years of relevant experience in Product Management, ERP Systems, Enterprise Software, Business Systems Analysis, or Product Development.
* Minimum 2–3 years of experience owning a product, module, or significant product roadmap.
* Demonstrated experience in defining and delivering ERP, multi-module enterprise products, or SaaS business applications.
* Proven experience in client-facing requirement discovery and stakeholder management.
* Practical understanding of API integrations, data flows, and system dependencies.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO).
* SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager.
* CBAP / CCBA or equivalent Business Analysis certification.
* Relevant ERP or Product Management certifications.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a product-oriented professional who combines business understanding, functional expertise, and technical awareness to drive ERP product development. The ideal candidate should be capable of independently managing product priorities, understanding complex business workflows, coordinating cross-functional teams, and making informed product decisions to deliver scalable and business-focused enterprise solutions.

Pay: ₹100,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Kochi, Kerala: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in ERP Product Management, ERP Functional Design, or Enterprise Software Development?
* Do you have hands-on experience in gathering business requirements and designing ERP workflows across modules such as Finance, Sales, Procurement, Inventory, HR, or CRM?
* Do you have experience preparing product requirement documents (PRDs), functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria while coordinating with development and QA teams?
* Are you an immediate joiner?

Work Location: In person

title: Dy. Manager Product Qualification Engineers-Power
description:
Amphenol FCI Kochi are seeking an Experienced and Innovative Senior Mechanical Product Validation Engineer to join our Power Products team. In this role, you will be responsible for Product Validation & Qualification of newly developed Power Connector Solutions starting from Proto build until Product launch. description:

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1743999
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Job title: Monitoring \& Management Product Manager**

  


**Job summary:**

  



The Monitoring \& Management Product Manager is responsible for the strategy, roadmap, governance, adoption and operational success of a global portfolio of vendor software platforms used to remotely monitor and manage audio visual (AV) and workplace technology devices. The role ensures these platforms provide reliable telemetry, actionable alerts, remote support capabilities and useful operational insights that improve service quality and the technology\-based office experience.

  



The Product Manager will work with Operations, Engineering, Information Security, Service Management, other product teams and technology vendors to translate business and operational needs into product capabilities. The role will guide platform selection and lifecycle decisions, establish support and governance models, drive integrations and automation, and measure the business value delivered by the portfolio.

  


**Key responsibilities (analytical/decision making/supervisory):**

  


* Own the global product strategy and multi\-year roadmap for AV telemetry, monitoring and remote management platforms.
* Lead proofs of concept and pilots; define success criteria, evaluate results and make evidence\-based recommendations for production adoption.
* Gather and prioritize requirements from Operations, Engineering, product teams and other stakeholders, balancing service value, effort, risk and cost.
* Manage the product lifecycle for assigned platforms, including evaluation, selection, onboarding, enhancement, integration, adoption, operational transition and retirement.
* Define platform standards for device onboarding, data consistency, health states, alerts, notifications, remote actions, and role\-based access.
* Drive integration with enterprise service management, event management, asset data, analytics and reporting capabilities to create and support automated workflows and improve leadership decision making.
* Establish service definitions for in\-scope platforms, ensure operational readiness requirements are met, integrate new platforms into PCD runbooks and Operations SOPs.
* Develop product KPIs and report on platform coverage, reliability, alert quality, adoption, automation, operational outcomes, cost and realized value.
* Ensure adequacy of on\-premise platform infrastructure, including server capacity, back\-up procedures, etc.
* Analyze telemetry and operational data to identify recurring issues, false positives, monitoring gaps and opportunities for proactive remediation or continuous improvement; collaborate with Operations to raise ITIL problems as appropriate.
* Manage strategic vendor relationships, licensing and service reviews; communicate EY requirements and influence vendor roadmaps.
* Prepare business cases, financial forecasts, investment recommendations and leadership updates for the product portfolio.
* Provide direction to internal teams, external suppliers and project resources delivering roadmap initiatives; the role may hold the “Sponsor’s Representative” role or coordinate work across teams without direct line\-management responsibility.
* Ensure platform decisions and changes are properly governed and align with EY security, privacy, compliance, architecture and operational resilience requirements.

  


**Knowledge, skills and experience requirements:**

  



To be successful in this role, candidates should exhibit the following core knowledge and skills:


* Strong product management experience in a global enterprise technology environment, including strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, lifecycle management and value realization.
* Experience managing software platforms for monitoring, observing and managing IoT endpoints, including unified communications, workplace technology or AV devices.
* Understanding of telemetry, events, device health, alerting, incident workflows, dashboards, APIs, data integration and management automation concepts.
* Ability to translate operational and technical requirements into clear product capabilities, user stories, acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes.
* Experience developing on\-boarding and support processes and operational transition plans for enterprise platforms.
* Strong analytical and financial skills, including business\-case development, cost\-benefit analysis, forecasting and KPI definition.
* Proven ability to build trusted relationships, influence decisions and gain consensus across diverse functions, cultures and geographies.
* Ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly and concisely to engineering teams, operational stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Experience managing vendors, licensing, contracts, performance reviews and product evaluations.
* Knowledge of AV, Microsoft Teams Rooms, unified communications, collaboration technology or workplace technology is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Teams Pro Management Portal, Utelogy, Cisco Control Hub, Poly Lens, Jabra\+, Neat Pulse, Crestron XiO Cloud, Logitech Sync, ServiceNow, Netcool or Power BI is beneficial.
* Ability to work autonomously, exercise sound judgment, manage competing priorities and lead through ambiguity.
* Fluent written and spoken English; flexibility to participate in periodic early or late meetings with global stakeholders. Travel is expected to be limited.

  


**Qualifications, certifications and education requirements:**

  


* Successful candidates will have the specific role experience noted below:
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.
* Typically 5 to 8 years of relevant experience in product management, IT operations, monitoring and management, unified communications, workplace technology or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience owning or significantly contributing to the lifecycle of enterprise software products or platforms used by global teams.
* Experience leading platform evaluations, proofs of concept, pilots and production deployments.
* Experience defining and tracking measurable business and operational outcomes for technology products.
* Product Management, ITIL, Agile, Scrum, SAFe or PMP certification is beneficial.
* AVIXA CTS or relevant Microsoft, Cisco or other collaboration technology certification is beneficial.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
